sources.entry: Agent Island - MacBook notch companion for Claude Code and Codex sessions, showing live status and auto-resuming selected long-running tasks. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/tristan666666/agent-island) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Agent Island - Free, MIT-licensed native companion for Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, and Cursor, with local session status, your-turn alerts, and provider usage views. #free #opensource

summary.one_liner: Agent Island is a macOS menu-bar/notch companion that shows live status for Claude, Codex and other AI coding agent sessions.
summary.what_it_does: The README was not available, so this summary relies on the metadata from two awesome-list entries. One listing describes it as a MacBook notch companion for Claude Code and Codex sessions that shows live status and auto-resumes selected long-running tasks. The other describes it as a free, MIT-licensed native companion for Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, and Cursor, with local session status, "your-turn" alerts, and provider usage views. Exact features and setup steps could not be verified from a README.
use_cases: monitor running Claude Code sessions from the menu bar
track Codex agent status on a MacBook notch
get alerted when an AI coding agent needs input
view provider usage for AI coding tools
notable: Sits in the MacBook notch area for at-a-glance agent status
Covers multiple AI coding agents including Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, and Cursor
Sends 'your-turn' alerts when an agent is waiting on the user
Listed as free and MIT-licensed in one awesome-list entry
caveats: README not available, so features and requirements are unverified
Appears to be macOS-only, based on the menu bar and MacBook notch descriptions
Auto-resume applies only to selected long-running tasks, per the listing
summary.license: MIT (per one awesome-list listing; README did not confirm)
keywords: get notified when agent needs input
